filter: Trust terciles taken WITHIN each coalition. ANES missing codes excluded via clean_var.
method: Per coalition, tercile-split the inverse-grievance trust composite; compute weighted % voting Clinton in the low-trust vs high-trust tercile; swing = high-trust% minus low-trust%. The figure uses the non-Republican coalition.
caveats: Vote is self-report (V162034a), not validated; pattern is the signal.
Campaign bar (≈0) is NOT computed here — it is Kalla & Broockman 2018 (APSR 112:148–166).

The §16 Figure B CDF series gives only ~11.3pp for 2016 because VCF0604 is absent from the CDF post-2012, degrading that composite to 2 coarse items. The timeseries items used here are more discriminating; the ~23pp is the better-grounded figure.
name: campaign_ceiling
